# COMPLICATED UTI (NO CATHETER)

# Complicated UTI is an infection beyond the bladder accompanied by symptoms

# including fever/other signs of systemic illness, flank pain, and costovertebral

# tenderness. This includes pyelonephritis and febrile or bacteremic UTI.

NOT signs or symptoms: abnormal urinalysis alone, pyuria, falls, change in urine

odor or color, delirium (acute mental status change, confusion) without systemic

signs of infection. These may occur in patients with a UTI but alone are

inadequate for diagnosis and empiric treatment.

# _______________________________________________________________________________

For patients without signs or symptoms of UTI:

[Asymptomatic bacteriuria](asymp-bacteriuria)

For patients presenting with septic shock from a suspected urinary tract

infection: Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Duration

Treat for 5 days with fluoroquinolones or 7 days with non-fluoroquinolone

organisms, presence of obstruction, underlying renal disease, immunosuppression,

and neurologic or structural abnormality in some cases. Often therapy can be

completed with an oral agent pending clinical stability and susceptibility

testing.

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Empirical treatment

Preferred:

[Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet q12h R,DI for 7 days](psozid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)

*Avoid trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole in the first and third trimesters

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)

< OR >

[Ciprofloxacin 750 mg PO q12h R,DI for 5 days](psozid2-ciprofloxacin-750mg-po-bid-5ds)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-ciprofloxacin-750mg-po-bid-5ds)

Alternative or isolate resistant to preferred antimicrobials:

[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h R for 7 days](psozid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-7ds-po-bid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-7ds-po-bid)

< OR >

[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h R for 7 days](psozid2-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid-7days)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid-7days)

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Treatment for specific pathogens

# Enterobacteria including E. coli, Klebsiella, and Proteus

Preferred:

[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h R for 7 days](psozid2-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid-7days)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid-7days)

Alternative or isolate resistant to preferred antimicrobials:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet q12h R,DI for 7 days](psozid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)

*Avoid trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole in the first and third trimesters

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)

# Staphylococcus aureus

S. aureus is an uncommon urinary tract pathogen and presence in the urine may be

due to hematogenous seeding from another site. Blood cultures are indicated to

rule out bacteremia in patients who have S. aureus isolated from the urine.

Consult Infectious Diseases for more information.

# Pseudomonas

Preferred:

[Ciprofloxacin 750 mg PO q12h R,DI for 5 days](psozid2-ciprofloxacin-750mg-po-bid-5ds)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-ciprofloxacin-750mg-po-bid-5ds)

# Enterococcus

Preferred:

[Amoxicillin 1000 mg PO q8h R for 7 days](psozid2-amoxicillin-1000mg-po-tid-7days)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amoxicillin-1000mg-po-tid-7days)

Alternative or isolate resistant to preferred antimicrobials:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Linezolid 600 mg PO q12h DI,O for 7 days](psozid2-linezolid-600mg-po-bid-x7days)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-linezolid-600mg-po-bid-x7days)
